content.introduction: According to Investtech, the S&P 500 is in a rising trend channel in the medium long term, indicating good market development, but it has broken a support level in the short term and is approaching resistance at 7800 points. The RSI curve shows a falling trend, signaling a possible trend reversal downwards. The index is technically neutral for the medium long term. Another Investtech source suggests a weak positive recommendation for the S&P 500 over one to six months, with the index approaching resistance at 7770 points. Investing.com provides technical analysis data showing the S&P 500 futures at 7,580.9, down 139.3 points, with various indicators suggesting a sell signal.
body:
S&P 500 is in a rising trend channel in the medium long term. This shows that investors over time have bought the index at higher prices and indicates good development for the market. However, the price has broken a support level in the short term and given a negative signal for the short term trading range. The index is approacing resistance at 7800 points, which may give a negative reaction. However, a break upwards through 7800 points will be a positive signal.
